column7: Third live occurrence of the -001/-002 defect shape: core.CreateProject's default-environment seeding and core.CreateProjectWithEnvs's requested-environment seeding (internal/core/catalog.go) both discarded a returned CreateEnvironment error as non-fatal (documented, intentional) but had no panic protection -- a panic on CreateEnvironment#1 propagated through CreateProject, past the already-committed Project row, producing a misleading 500 for a request that had, in fact, already succeeded (oracle (a): Differing tables: [Project]). Found live by FuzzStorageFaultOperations's own coverage-guided fuzzing in CI on PR #1988 (fix/1962-shared-fuzzworld's shared fuzzworld harness refresh), not a hand-written seed; users.go's own comment had already (wrongly) claimed this exact site was fixed. Fixed by wrapping both CreateEnvironment calls in the same defer/recover idiom as -001/-002. Proving test is the fuzz harness itself -- corpus entry ad8a1c49b476fc19 is the permanent regression (hand-constructed via the harness's own decodeFuzzOp byte layout to reproduce CI's finding exactly, red/green confirmed against the pre-fix commit). See docs/findings/2026-09-22-FINDING-secret-delete-restore-dependency-emission-panic-masks-success.md. Regression-corpus fidelity note (2026-09-27): ADR-108 Phase 6 step 14c's opCatalog shrink silently retargeted this corpus file's decoded operation from "REST POST /api/v1/projects" to an unrelated op -- repaired by re-encoding the file's byte[0] to the same op's new index, verified to decode back to the original op/method/NthCall/kind tuple; guarded going forward by TestOpcatalogCorpusFilesTargetPinnedOps (server/faultops/opcatalog_corpus_pin_test.go).
